# Lab 17.4: Create a Data Clean Room

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a data clean room, add data with analysis rules (aggregation threshold, join restriction, list overlap), and let a partner run only safe queries.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Prepare customer data with a privacy rule.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lab17_dcr OPTIONS (location = 'US');

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW lab17_dcr.customers_safe
OPTIONS (privacy_policy = '{"aggregation_threshold_policy": {"threshold": 50, "privacy_unit_columns": ["user_id"]}}')
AS SELECT id AS user_id, country, age, traffic_source
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Query with the threshold.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT WITH AGGREGATION_THRESHOLD country, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users
FROM lab17_dcr.customers_safe
GROUP BY country;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Groups with fewer than 50 users are dropped. `SELECT *` on the view is not allowed.

3. **[Console] Create the clean room.** **Sharing (Analytics Hub) → Create clean room** (`BQ Course Clean Room`, region US). Click **Add data**, choose `lab17_dcr.customers_safe`, and set:
   - **Analysis rule**: Aggregation threshold, 50, privacy unit `user_id`
   - **Join restriction**: partners may join only on `user_id`
   - Turn on **egress controls**

4. **[Console] Add a list-overlap rule.** Add another view with the **List overlap** rule, so partners can only learn which IDs appear in both lists, not other columns.

5. **[Console] Add a subscriber.** Give the partner account **Analytics Hub Subscriber** on the clean room. From the partner project, subscribe and run an aggregated query.

6. **[CLI] Run the thresholded query from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT WITH AGGREGATION_THRESHOLD traffic_source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users FROM lab17_dcr.customers_safe GROUP BY traffic_source'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Clean room | Shared space for privacy-safe analysis |
| Aggregation threshold | Small groups hidden |
| Join restriction | Joins only on allowed keys |
| Raw rows | Never visible to the partner |
